title: 翻译模拟测试
goal: 核对译文的信息、句子组织和词形

points.label: 识别译文的遗漏和含义错误
选择信息完整的英文句子
选择准确且形式正确的词语

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 四级翻译要求把 1 段 140–160 字的中文译成英语，限时 30 分钟。整段翻译在段落翻译练习中完成。
整段译文按总体印象评分。本课小测核对信息、句子组织和词形三项，得分不等于译文成绩。

groups.text: 中文：这座桥过去供行人使用，现在也允许自行车通行。

items.stem: Which translation preserves both uses of the bridge?
options: The bridge once served pedestrians and now also allows bicycles.
The bridge once served bicycles and now also allows pedestrians.
The bridge has always served bicycles but has never allowed pedestrians.
The bridge now serves pedestrians but no longer allows bicycles.
items.why: 原文说过去供行人使用，现在也允许自行车通行，对应第一项。

groups.text: 中文：村民先修理水渠，然后用河水灌溉田地。

items.stem: Which translation preserves the order of actions?
options: The villagers irrigated the fields before repairing the channel.
The villagers repaired the channel and then irrigated the fields with river water.
The villagers repaired the fields and then irrigated the channel with river water.
The villagers irrigated the channel and then repaired the river beside the fields.
items.why: 原文先修理水渠，再用河水灌溉田地，对应第二项。

groups.text: 中文：当地博物馆展示了居民过去使用的工具。

items.stem: Which translation is a complete sentence with the original meaning?
options: The local museum displaying tools that residents once used.
The local museum, which displays tools used by residents.
The local museum displays tools that residents once used.
The tools used by the local museum once displayed residents.
items.why: 第三项主语和谓语齐全，定语从句 that residents once used 对应居民过去使用的。第一项的 displaying 不能作谓语，句子不完整。

groups.text: 中文：由于道路改善，村民到市场更加方便。

items.stem: Which translation preserves the cause and result?
options: The road improved because villagers reached the market more easily.
The market improved because villagers built a new road.
The road improved, although villagers could not reach the market.
Improved roads made it easier for villagers to reach the market.
items.why: 道路改善是原因，到市场更方便是结果，对应第四项。

groups.text: 中文：这条河为附近的农田提供水源。

items.stem: Arrange the chunks to translate the sentence.
items.why: provides 是谓语，water 是宾语，for nearby fields 指受益对象。

groups.text: 中文：居民在旧车站举办展览。

items.stem: Arrange the chunks to translate the sentence.
items.why: hold 是谓语，an exhibition 是宾语，地点状语位于句末。

groups.text: 中文：这些工人去年修复了屋顶。

items.stem: Complete the translation with the past form of repair: The workers ____ the roof last year.
items.why: last year 表示过去时间，repair 用过去式 repaired。

groups.text: 中文：这两个村庄有共同的市场。

items.stem: Complete the translation with the plural form of village: The two ____ share a market.
items.why: two 后接复数名词，village 的复数是 villages。
